name: Cholon
summary: The Chinese district of Saigon. Larry remembers off-duty visits to the French swimming pool there — the setting of the pool photographs VN-0004 and VN-0005, where he swam with Ron Tototz and a friend whose name he can no longer recall.
researchNotes: The 'French swimming pool' most plausibly refers to the Cercle Sportif–style colonial pool facilities that survived into the American period; period Saigon guides and veteran accounts of Cholon recreation spots could identify the specific pool and corroborate the English FIRST AID signage visible in VN-0004/VN-0005.
